title: Cloudinary Pricing 2026: Plans, Credits and Costs
summary: Cloudinary pricing charges monthly credits that cover storage, bandwidth, and image transformations. Compare the exact costs of all plan options.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is Cloudinary free to use?


Yes, Cloudinary has a Free plan, and for a small app it can cover real production traffic. It draws on the same credit pool as every paid plan, so storage, bandwidth and transformations all count against one allowance.


If one image-heavy page gets popular, a free account that looks idle can still run out quickly, so watch the pool, not the price.


### Does Cloudinary roll over unused credits?


**Treat unused credits as gone** . Cloudinary's plans are built around a recurring allowance, not a prepaid balance you draw down over time, so a quiet month doesn't bank room for a busy one.


For budgeting, that means sizing a plan to your typical month plus a margin for spikes. Don't count on a slow stretch to pay for a launch.


### What happens when I exceed my Cloudinary credits?


It depends on the plan, and this is where the bill surprises people.


On the Free plan, going over generally means Cloudinary asks you to upgrade, since its limits are soft limits. On paid plans, the choice is between paying for usage beyond the allowance and moving up a tier.


Run both numbers before you decide. If you're regularly over, the next plan's included credits usually cost less than the same usage billed as overage.


If the overage was a one-off spike, paying it is the cheaper path.


### Can I switch Cloudinary plans mid-billing cycle?


From your account settings, you can change plans, and an upgrade is the move you'll most often want mid-cycle, when the pool is draining faster than expected. Don't assume the old and new allowances stack or that charges are prorated in your favor.


Check the billing summary in your account before confirming, and compare the new plan's included credits against what you've already burned this cycle.


Anything that needs a conversation with sales to explain should make you pause, and the self-serve tiers shouldn't need one.


### Does Cloudinary offer annual or startup discounts?


Cloudinary has offered annual billing on its paid plans, which typically costs less per month than paying monthly in exchange for a longer commitment. It has also run a program aimed at early-stage startups.


Terms and eligibility change, so confirm them on Cloudinary's current pricing and startup pages before you plan around either one.


Commit annually only once your credit usage has been stable for a few cycles. Locking in a plan you're about to outgrow, or one far bigger than you need, turns a discount into a cost.
